fix_code:
N = int(input())
S = input()
C = list(map(int, input().split()))

min_cost = 10**18

for i in range(N - 1):
    if S[i] != S[i + 1]:
        cost = min(C[i], C[i + 1])
        min_cost = min(min_cost, cost)

print(min_cost)
